notes.title: Artistic/Gameplay Rework Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

After long consideration, we've decided to rework this game into stylized graphics. This is for several reasons:
[list]
[*] Broader appeal to all age groups (And yes we will drop this game down from rated M to E, or at most T)
[*] Substantially smaller installation size
[*] Faster development iteration
[/list]

Additionally, rather than approaching this game as a collection of stories, we are changing this game to be an open world game, drawing inspiration from various games of this genre (Breath of the Wild, Hogwarts Legacy, Skyrim, etc).

Check out the trailer:

[previewyoutube=Ce7ixP6SMDI;full][/previewyoutube]

We are working on an English-only patch to be released as soon as we can, but will then start working on new languages!

We appreciate your patience.

Thanks,
Zac
